title: Tin
body:
Stone tools are no more. Instead, find Tin Ore, smelt it into Tin Ingots and make tools out of those. It isn't all bad: tin can also be made into armour, which stone couldn't.

Stat-wise, Tin tools have the same durability stone tools used to have, and Tin armour has identical stats to chainmail.

![image: Tin](media/1420951514603851947.png)

Tool durability in general has also been adjusted, to create a more gradual increase rather than a huge jump between iron (previously 250) and diamond (1531):

* Wooden tools: 128
* Tin tools: 250
* Iron tools: 650
